notes: Fallback, parcel-level: no county or city-wide zoning district layer is published. Each parcel carries its municipality ZONING code (e.g. RR, 1) rather than district polygons; only parcels with a recorded code are included, and codes are the assessor's, with no district names. Towns with no recorded codes are absent. City of Rensselaer district polygons exist separately (services2.arcgis.com/8T9oLChn87ExnqDl, layer 25).
